configurations.// crosstabs-dev: DEFAULT (listed first) because it has no external dependencies -- just the local .venv. Flask dev server with auto-reload, so template/CSS/Python edits apply immediately. Chromium is installed in the venv (python -m playwright install chromium), so real crosstab runs work here given a valid session. The one thing it cannot do is the streamed Decipher login, which needs xvfb/x11vnc/novnc -- those exist only in the Docker image, and attempting it returns a clear 503 rather than failing obscurely.
configurations.name: crosstabs-dev

configurations.// crosstabs-docker: Full app: Playwright Chromium for real runs, and xvfb/x11vnc/novnc for the streamed Decipher login. REQUIRES the Docker daemon to be running -- preview_start fails outright if Docker Desktop is not up. Code is baked into the image, so rebuild to pick up edits: docker build -t ghcr.io/itayole/crosstabs-portal:latest . If port 5000 is reported busy, it is usually a leftover container from a previous run: docker rm -f crosstabs-preview.
configurations.name: crosstabs-docker
